'''Massassi-blossom tea''' was a type of [[Tea/Legends|tea]] that could be brewed from the [[Flower/Legends|blossoms]] of the [[Massassi tree/Legends|Massassi trees]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. The [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] had the effect of reducing fever in a sick or wounded individual. At one point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Pippa Rosheed]], the leader of the [[Fernandin Scouting Expedition]]'s [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] team, thought of using Massassi-blossom tea in order to manufacture a cure against a [[Unidentified plague (Yavin 13)|plague]] that had broken out on the moon [[Yavin 13/Legends|Yavin 13]], and her team eventually managed to successfully do so at a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] aboard the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system's]] [[Imperial Salvage Station]].

==Description==
Massassi-blossom tea,<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> or Massassi blossom tea, was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] that could be brewed from the [[Flower/Legends|blossoms]] of the [[Massassi tree/Legends|Massassi trees]], which grew on the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], a part of the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]<ref name="GG2-2" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The blossoms used in the preparation process were found at the [[Tree/Legends|trees']] branch junctures that received direct [[Yavin/Legends|sunlight]]. The [[Tea/Legends|tea]] reduced fever, having an application value on a sick or wounded individual comparable to that of a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]]. The Massassi tree blossoms could also be gathered and preserved for later use.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==History==
At one point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Dates">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]] is set between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] of the [[Fernandin Scouting Expedition]] unwittingly brought a [[Unidentified plague (Yavin 13)|disease]] onto the Yavin [[Star system/Legends|system's]] moon [[Yavin 13/Legends|Yavin 13]] that endangered its native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Gerb]]s and the [[Slith]], and, after undergoing a mutation, also [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="GG2-2" />

{{RPGseed}}
[[File:Pippa_Rosheed.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Doctor Pippa Rosheed thought of using Massassi-blossom tea to manufacture a cure against a plague on Yavin 13.]]
A team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents that was sent around that [[Time/Legends|time]] to pick up a group of undercover Rebel [[Diplomat/Legends|negotiators]] on Yavin 13 was prevented from doing so by the moon being quarantined. Instead, the agents sought out the Fernandin Scouting Expedition's [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] team led by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Pippa Rosheed]]. After the team made contact with the biologists on Yavin 4, Rosheed grudgingly admitted having a theory that a cure to the [[Disease/Legends|disease]] could be made through the use of Massassi-blossom tea, though she needed sophisticated scientific equipment in order to test and determine the correct amounts needed. Ultimately, the Rebel team sneaked the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] aboard the Yavin system's [[Imperial Salvage Station]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], where they accessed a [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] and successfully manufactured a cure.<ref name="GG2-2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Massassi-blossom tea was introduced in ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]'', a [[1989]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book includes an outline for a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure that involves the beverage, and this article assumes the scenario plays out as described.<ref name="GG2" /> In one instance, [[Jonatha Ariadne Caspian]]'s [[1995]] [[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|Second Edition]] of ''Galaxy Guide 2'' also erroneously spells the name of the tea as "massassi-blossom trea."<ref name="GG2-2" />
